decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk extends the established office line into a growing workplace segment and has its own page; its prospects are still unresolved and carrying it costs little, so the option is worth keeping.
A chair family close to the core offer is cheap to keep in a configurable portfolio, and one year on the market is too short to have resolved its value.
Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche accessory with uncertain demand, but they reuse existing materials and cost little to carry, so keeping the option open is still justified.
The soft sofa is close to the core upholstery business and costs little to keep, though it is only mentioned on the website, which suggests weaker emphasis and some risk of being phased out.
The high standing table fits the lounge and conference offer at low carrying cost, and its value has not yet resolved.

The rug collection is distant from the core business and draws on outside designers and sourcing, which raises carrying costs given the firm's many other options, but it is too early to judge it as resolved negatively.
